comments: Elegant use of Floquet engineering for polarization selectivity; performance limited by suboptimal coupling at shorter wavelengths.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tailored inter-ring dispersion creates complementary polarization-dependent band gaps
hypotheses.result: TE via topological edge state, TM suppressed; behavior reverses at shorter wavelengths
